method: Full final authored documents read through MQ; manual sentence, paragraph, series and meaning audit
standards-006: Three selection actions use bold two-word lead-ins. Three printed values use a nested labelled list. Three reference topics use a labelled list. Explicit companion selection, checksum refusal and no implicit repair remain.
